_metadata.description: OT-P0-002 — guided section-by-section authoring with autofill and a structure-validation gate.

requirements.title: Guided section-by-section authoring with a structure-validation gate
requirements.description: The wizard walks the plan's sections in order, validates structure as it goes, and refuses to finalize while a mandatory section (or a phase's acceptance) is empty. The flow is followable by a small model with minimal context.

validation.notes: Structure-validation gate rejects empty mandatory sections and missing anchors.
Section-by-section progression exposes the next required section until complete.

requirements.title: Auto-fill the mechanical sections so the model only supplies prose
requirements.description: The wizard auto-fills the deterministic sections — regression anchor (via git-control-tower baseline), required-reading (via prompt-manager plan-skill-discovery), and code references (via code-facts) — degrading gracefully when a source is unavailable, so genuine prose is the only thing left for the agent.

validation.notes: Autofill fills mechanical sections when substrate seams are healthy.
Autofilled references round-trip through finalize into structured plan references.
